item.title: Agencies Announce Dollar Thresholds for Smaller Loan Exemption from Appraisal Requirements for Higher-priced Mortgage Loans
item.description: The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, the Federal Reserve Board, and the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency today announced that the 2027 threshold for higher-priced mortgage loans that are subject to special appraisal requirements will increase from $34,200 to $35,500.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.category: Appraisals, Credit, Mortgage Banking / Residential Lending, Retail Credit
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: Comptroller Gould Emphasizes OCC’s Continued Momentum to Rightsize Regulation and Reform Federal Banking System
item.description: Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan V. Gould today discussed the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency's accelerated pace of execution and continued efforts to reform bank supervision, open the federal banking system to new entrants, and embrace responsible innovation to drive economic growth and deliver for the American people in remarks at the Exchequer Club.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.category: Bank Management, Charters & Licensing, Community Bank, Laws & Regulations
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: Agencies Extend Comment Period for Proposed Third-Party Risk Management Guidance
item.description: The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, the Federal Reserve Board, the National Credit Union Administration, and the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency today announced that they will extend, until December 16, the comment period for proposed guidance on managing risks associated with third-party relationships. Comments on the proposal were originally due November 16.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.category: Bank Information Technology (BIT), Bank-Fintech Arrangements, Examination Process, Supervision of Third Party Technology Service Providers - BIT, Third Party Risk Management
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: Federal Bank Regulatory Agencies Release 2025 Small Business, Small Farm, and Community Development Lending Data
item.description:
Federal Bank Regulatory Agencies Release 2025 Small Business, Small Farm, and Community Development Lending Data
The federal bank regulatory agencies, as members of the Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC), today released data on small business, small farm, and community development lending during 2025. The Community Reinvestment Act regulations require the agencies to annually disclose these data.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.category: Community Reinvestment Act (CRA), Rural Economic Development, Small Business
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
